messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — I found a regression in kvcache with long sequences causing OOMs in some jobs. I have a tiny fix ready in a branch.
Alex Kim: Can you link the PR? we should decide whether to backport to 1.13.x
Maya Patel: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4378 — 3-line change, unit tests added.
Ricardo Soto: reviewed locally, minimal diff. If we're doing a patch release, we need a cutoff by 18:00 UTC to make it for tomorrow's deploy window.
Priya Nair: fine with that. who's taking the backport? I can do the cherry-pick + smoke on staging.
Maya Patel: Priya that'd be great. Command I'll use:
```bash
git checkout -b backport/1.13.2-pr4378 origin/release/1.13.x
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
# run unit tests
make smoke-infra
```
Alex Kim: changelog entry (very short):
```markdown
- Fix: kvcache OOM when serving long sequences (PR #4378)
```
release-bot: Release checklist created: https://ci.redwood/patch-1.13.2-4378 — ETA: 24h pipeline. @Priya Nair assign please :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: assigned and running cherry-pick now.
Ricardo Soto: pinging infra to open a priority slot for the staging smoke — @infra-team can we get a quick slot around 16:30 UTC?
Maya Patel: also note: no model weight changes, no migration scripts. should be safe for a fast patch.
Alex Kim: LGTM on process. If CI passes, let's cut the tag and release notes tomorrow morning. :rocket:
Priya Nair: cherry-pick done, tests passing locally, pushing to staging. I'll post results in this thread.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone. if anything blocks, escalate here. otherwise aim for 18:00 UTC cutoff.
Priya Nair: smoke passed on staging at 16:42 UTC — no regressions observed.
Alex Kim: moving to finalize changelog and tag tomorrow. closing loop unless issues crop up.
